Plantain Chips
By: Alejandro Duarte
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




3 green plantains
2 cloves of garlic
2 tablespoons salt
Vegetable oil

Preparation

1 Peel the plantains. Shred the plantains into a bowl and mix all the ingredients. Scoop it out in a tablespoon size to form a patty. Deep fry until it's golden. Once golden, remove from the golden pan and sit on paper towel until they are dry. Sprinkle them with a little bit of salt.
